lines.speaker: night_supervisor
lines.text: Nights. Somebody has to be allocated to an empty building, and it has been me for six years, and I have stopped regarding that as a punishment.

lines.speaker: night_supervisor
lines.text: Your desk is still yours. Enforcement have been up four times and not once opened the drawer, because opening a drawer is not on anybody's work order and nothing off the work order happens.

lines.speaker: night_supervisor
lines.text: You cleared the gate drone at Kell village. That went round this office. Nobody said one word out loud and everybody knew by Thursday.

lines.speaker: night_supervisor
lines.text: You outran two of them on the valley road the night you left. I logged it as a maintenance excursion. It is the only interesting form I have filed in six years and I took my time over it.
